---
name: WorkoutAtlas Frontend
description: "Use for Vue 3, Vite, router, responsive UI, browser workflows, and frontend testing in WorkoutAtlas."
applyTo: "frontend/**"
---

- Preserve Vue 3 Composition patterns and existing component conventions.
- Read `docs/engineering/CURRENT-STATE.md` before UI changes.
- Use `frontend/src/config/env.js` for API base resolution.
- Keep authorization checks in the backend even if UI visibility changes.
- Preserve protected mobile navigation and existing preview/session behavior.
- Run the frontend production build for UI changes and project-owned tests where applicable.
